# What the playbook does from minute 5 to minute 10

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | enemies |
| Result | refuted |
| Created | L1.I4 |
| Updated | L1.I10 |

## Hypothesis

The unchanged playbook survives from 5:00 to 10:00 on Nightmare 1 from the minute-5 gym. The damage sources and the moments of health loss show what to fix first for the later minutes and higher levels.

## Method

Play the minute-5-nm1 gym for 300 s with the playbook as it is. Read health by minute, hurt-by sources, bosses, elites, goals and dashes.

## Findings

The unchanged playbook did not survive from the minute-5 gym: it died at 5:59, and the boss-knob and chest-first variants died even sooner (5:29, 5:20). A strong late build (minute-10 gym) survived with no health loss. A fresh seeker-sprouts game reached 5:00 at 121/162 health. The rehearsal showed the danger starts at 2:00-3:30 for thin builds. What matters is how many chests and evolutions the build has when the swarms and bosses arrive.
